_comment: Reviewed exceptions for tools/check_page_sizes.py. Key = repo-relative path, value = the review's stated reason for keeping the page unsplit despite crossing a WARNING threshold. No blanket allowlist entries - each key must name a specific, reviewed page. IMPORTANT: an entry here waives an advisory warning ONLY. It cannot waive the 300-line hard ceiling, which is checked before this file is consulted.
_retired_2026-09-02: 12_Engineering_and_Systems/analysis/Lighting_Design.md was the first and only entry in this file, added 2026-09-01 when the page stood at ~410 lines and 11 sections. Its own stated review condition was 'REVIEW AGAIN if the section count reaches 12'. On 2026-09-02 the page was split under the new 300-line ceiling - fixtures and glare/room-by-room moved to their own pages - and now stands at 268 lines across 10 top-level sections, below both the ceiling and the cluster trigger. The exception is no longer needed and was removed rather than left to rot. Recorded here rather than silently deleted, because the reasoning it carried about merges being undone by splits is still worth knowing.
